intro.text: All references to “we,” “us,” “our,” “RMHC” “Royalty”, or the “Company” in this Annual Report on Form 10-K mean Royalty Management Holding Corporation. We were a blank check company formed under the laws of the State of Delaware on January 20, 2021 for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, recapitalization, reorganization or other similar business combination with one or more target businesses (a “Business Combination”). On October 31, 2023, we consummated a merger with Royalty Management Corporation, an Indiana corporation (“RMC”), whereby RMC became a wholly owned subsidiary of RMHC. Through this combination, RMHC became a royalty company building shareholder value to benefit both its shareholders and communities by acquiring and developing high value assets in a variety of market environments.

lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Accrued liabilities
lines.why: Services and other costs not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Other current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current assets minus the current lines above: current assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current assets (total assets − current assets) minus the non-current lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current liabilities minus the current lines above: current liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current liabilities (total liabilities − current liabilities) minus the non-current lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

s.t: In March 2022 and September 2022, the Company made a series of investments totaling $ 250,000 into convertible debt of Ferrox.

As part of its investment in the convertible debt of Ferrox, the Company also received an additional 166,667 common shares of Ferrox at each of the five dates of investment that took place during March and September 2022, for a total 833,335 common shares.
